newsitem.title: EGYPT: Upper Egypt Flour dividend approved.
newsitem.headline: Upper Egypt Flour dividend approved.

text.p: The shareholders of Upper Egypt Flour Mills approved a dividend of 3.85 pounds a share for the financial year 1995/6 at a general assembly on Monday, brokers said. The year ended June 30.
The dividend was in line with expectations but shares rose to 69.75 pounds at 1330 GMT, from 68.80 at Sunday's close.
In 1994/5, when the state was the only shareholder, the shareholders' portion of profits was 13.86 million pounds, equivalent to 1.98 pounds for each of the seven million shares.
The state sold the private sector at least 40 percent of the company shares in September at 40.00 pounds a share.
